Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players have made their way out to the middle. Fakhar Zaman and Imam-ul-Haq are at the crease.
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then! Pakistan require 314 runs from 50 overs to go 1-0 up in the ODI series. The pitch is a good one to bat on and Pakistan would be confident going into the chase. The Aussies have a couple of leggies in their bowling attack and they would be key for Australia. Who will come out on top? Stay tuned to find that out as the chase begins shortly.

The debutant, Zahid Mahmood (10-0-59-2) comes up for a quick chat. The leggie says that he had planned for Alex Carey and wanted to bowl a googly from the leg stump line. Shares that there is some help for the spinners. Tells that they didn't bowl well at the start but recovered well towards the end. Mentions that the advice from Babar was to dry up the runs. States that they have good batters and hopes to chase down the target.

Pakistan's bowlers were taken to the cleaners in Powerplay 1 and it was their spinners who got them back into the contest. Zahid Mahmood got the wicket of Aaron Finch and Iftikhar Ahmed bowled tight lines and lengths to keep the Aussie batters on their toes. Khushdil Shah and Iftikhar Ahmed got one wicket apiece and were quite economical. Head's wicket turned the tide back in Pakistan's favour and the run out of Ben McDermott completely sucked the momentum out of the Australian innings.

Australia got off to a great start and it was Travis Head who went absolutely berserk in Powerplay 1. Although Aaron Finch struggled to time the ball, he did manage to hang in there for a while alongside Head. They stitched together an opening stand of 110 runs before Finch departed. Head carried on in his merry way and brought up his second ODI hundred. After his departure, there was yet another stand between Ben McDermott and Marnus Labuschagne and the former also notched up his maiden ODI fifty. The run out of Ben gave Pakistan a good opening and they made full use of it by picking more wickets. It was the pair of Marcus Stoinis and Cameron Green that provided some stability and it is Green's unbeaten knock of 40 that propelled Australia to a 300-plus total.

An excellent recovery at the backend from Pakistan! Australia would be a tad disappointed, in spite of crossing the 300-run mark, as they were cruising along nicely at the halfway mark and it seemed like the Aussies would easily cross 350, with plenty of batting still to come. They were 171/1 at one point but lost 6 wickets for 125 runs after that. Having said that, the tourists did score 81 runs in the last 10 overs and that ensured that they post a competitive total on the board.

FOUR! Green ends the innings well! Short in length, around middle, Cameron Green sits on the back foot and pulls it powerfully through square leg. The field had come up in that direction and the ball speeds away to the fence. 15 from the over, Australia finish on 313/7!
A low dipping full toss around leg, Green clips it to wide long on and scampers back for the second run.
Short fine leg drops back. Square leg comes up...
FOUR! Vital runs! Wasim serves it on a length and close to off, Cameron Green walks across the stumps and scoops it over short fine leg for a boundary.
A low full toss around leg, Green steps back to whip it on the leg side but only gets an inside edge onto the pads. It deflects towards mid-wicket, the bowler runs after it but they get two.
Short and on middle, Ellis turs inside the crease with the pull shot but only manages to get an inside edge. It rolls towards short fine leg and they cross.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and forces it towards mid off for a run. 300 up for Australia!
Wide! Wasim sees the batter shuffling across the stumps and slips a full ball down the leg side. Green misses and it's too wide down the leg side.
Who will bowl the last over of the innings? Mohammad Wasim it is.
Fullish and around leg, pushed back past the bowler to long off for a couple of runs.
The debutant, Nathan Ellis is the new batter in.

OUT! Timber! This is very skilful from Haris Rauf. Dishes out a slower one by rolling his fingers on the side of the ball. The length is a bit short and the line is close to off, Sean Abbott hangs on the back foot, looking to heave it away but is way too early into the shot. He misses and the stumps take another beating.
Back of a length around off, Green drags his attempted pull shot down to deep square leg for one.
A leg-stump line delivery, a low full toss, Abbott digs it out down the ground for a run as it's stopped at mid on.

LUCKY FOUR! Haris Rauf delivers a well-directed short ball, around leg and following the batter, Sean Abbott tries to pull but again gets a top edge. This time it flies behind the keeper and finds the fence.
Short in length and around off, skidding off the surface, Abbott top-edges his pull shot and it falls in no man's land at deep mid-wicket. Two taken.
Serves it on a length and around off, Abbott tries to slog it over the leg side but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It deflects to covers and they cross. 10 from the over!
FOUR! Cheeky! Fuller in length and in the line of the stumps, Sean Abbott walks across the stumps and spoons it over short fine leg for a boundary.
Play and a miss! This has beaten everything. In the line of the stumps, Sean swings his bat at it but misses. The ball goes very closely past the stumps to the keeper.
A high full toss around off, Green moves back inside the crease and hits it down to mid off for a single. That looked quite high but not given as a no ball.
A low full toss around leg, Green steps back to make room and knocks it down to wide long on. He presses for two, the fielder fumbles and Cameron gets two.
Wide! Drifting down the leg side, Green tries his best to get some bat behind it but misses. A good stop by Mohammad Rizwan.
Fuller in length and around off, it's pushed down to long on for a single.
Mohammad Wasim (6-0-34-0) is back on. Will he get into the wickets column?
Fuller this time, around off, Green drives it down the ground but finds mid off. Top over from Rauf!
Fractionally short and close to off, Sean taps it down towards backward point for a run.
Sean Abbott is the new batter in.

OUT! BOWLED! A body blow to Australia at the backend of the innings as Marcus Stoinis departs. This is very clever bowling from Haris Rauf. He delivers it touch short and around off, at 129.5 kph. Marcus Stoinis camps on the back foot and tries to heave it over the leg side. But the ball arrives late and cuts back in a shade as well to beat his big swinging blade. It then goes on to light the bails and Haris Rauf is up and running in celebration.
Big swing and a miss! Seam up, on a shortish length around off, at 134 clicks, Marcus Stoinis stands back to pull but fails to connect.
In the zone outside off, on a length, Green goes on the back foot and slaps it to deep cover for a single.
Slower delivery, a touch short and on off, Stoinis rocks back and works it through square leg for a run.
Haris Rauf (6-0-31-0) is back on.
Short in length and on off, Marcus goes back and pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Excellent yorker, Green digs it out back past the bowler towards mid on and takes one.
A low full toss on off, Stoinis hits it down to long on for a run.
Drifting down the leg side, on a length, Stoinis tucks it behind square leg and collects a couple of runs.
Slower one, on a length and around off, played down from the crease to cover-point for a run.
SIX! This is outrageous! Cameron Green flexes his muscles, finds the delivery in his arc and sends it miles over mid-wicket for a maximum. The big man is showing his raw power!
SIX! That is a top shot from Marcus Stoinis! This is tossed up, around off. Stoinis gets inside the line of the ball and goes inside-out, wide of the long off fielder and bags a maximum.
Floated, full and outside off. Marcus Stoinis miscues his cover drive towards the extra cover fielder.
Flat and quicker through the air, outside off. Green cuts it past the cover fielder and rotates the strike.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Marcus Stoinis cuts it to deep cover and takes a run.
Greens skips down the track and eases it to long off for a single.
DROPPED! Stoinis comes down the track and slaps this full ball uppishly towards extra cover. Imam-ul-Haq there hops to grab the ball but the ball goes through his hands. The batters cross ends.
Short of a length, on middle. Marcus punches it down to long on for a run.

HULK IS LUCKY! A pinpoint yorker from Ali, around middle. Marcus gets his bat down in time and keeps it out. But the ball rolls away and hits the stumps. Although the bails do not come off and Marcus survives.
On a length, angling in from middle. Green tucks it to the leg side and settles for a run.
Leg bye! Excellent change of pace from Ali! A slower bumper, around off. Marcus gets early in his pull shot and he misses. The ball ricochets off his shoulder towards third man for another leg bye.
A length ball, jagging back in sharply from off and cramping the batter for room. Green misses his whip on the leg side and gets hit on his pad. The ball rolls to the leg side for a leg bye.
Back of a length, angling in from middle, Green hangs back and wrists it to mid-wicket.
This is another flatter ball, that goes on with the angle from off. Cameron Green punches it to long off and collects a single. Shah has done a very impressive job thus far.
Shah bowls it slower through the air, full and well outside off. Green carves it wide of the long off fielder and comes back for the second run.
Shorter and quicker, outside off. Green cuts hard but straight to the point fielder.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Marcus Stoinis punches it through the cover region and takes a run.
Looped up, on a length, outside off. Green advances down the track and works it to long off for one run.
Floated, on a length, around off. Marcus cuts it to deep cover for a run.
FOUR! Easy pickings! A juicy full toss, around middle and leg. Green sits back and flicks this through the mid-wicket region for a boundary. That was a gift and Green cashed in!
Back of a length, around off. Green taps it towards cover and looks for a run but is rightly sent back by Marcus.
A slower ball, into the wicket, around off. Marcus Stoinis punches it down to long on and settles for a single.
Wide! Ali spills this one down leg. Stoinis misses his flick and the umpire signals wide.
Good-length ball, outside off. Green skips down and pushes it past the cover fielder for a quick run.
A slower ball, into the surface, around off. Marcus Stoinis pulls it along the ground towards deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Marcus Stoinis stays back and punches it towards mid off.
Change in bowling. Hasan Ali (5-0-34-0) is back on.
Flatter and quicker, around off. Cameron Green taps it towards cover. Just 3 runs off it.
Slightly shorter in length, outside off. Marcus Stoinis cuts it past the point fielder and takes a single.
Green skips down the track and works this full ball towards long on for a run.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Marcus cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Floated, on a length, on off. Marcus pushes it to the cover fielder.
Tossed up, around off. Marcus Stoinis blocks it out.
End of Powerplay 2! Pakistan can now have a maximum of 5 fielders outside the ring till the 50th over.
Slower through the air, a touch short and on off, Green goes on the back foot and defends it down. 10-0-59-2, not a bad debut for Zahid Mahmood!
Full and flighted outside off, Stoinis stretches forward and caresses it down to long off for a run.
Flatter and shorter on middle, it's punched down to long on for a single.
Tossed up, around off and spinning away, Cameron goes on the back foot and defends it down.
Cameron Green walks out to bat now.

OUT! BOWLED AROUND HIS LEGS! What has Carey done here? This is a very ordinary shot selection from him given the situation of the game. A googly from Zahid Mahmood, he feeds it full and around leg, Alex Carey tries to be inventive with his reverse-batted shot but fails to connect. It lands and goes on to shatter the stumps. Australia are losing the plot badly here!
Loopy and full around off, Carey paddles it down to fine leg for two.
Floated and full around middle, Carey sweeps it aerially but safely to deep mid-wicket for one. 4 runs and a wicket from this over!
Skidding down the leg side, helped through mid-wicket for another run.
Full and on middle, swept to deep square leg for a run.
Short and on off, punched to deep cover for one.

Huge shout for a caught behind! The finger has gone up and Marcus Stoinis takes the DRS. The UltraEdge finds a flat line and the decision is reversed. Loopy and full around off, gripping and spinning away, Marcus leans to drive but gets beaten. Rizwan appeals for a catch, gets the decision in his favour but technology comes to the rescue of Marcus Stoinis.
Alex Carey walks out to bat.

OUT! WHAT A CATCH! Khushdil Shah has a wicket and Pakistan are doing a great job of chipping away at the wickets. Floated and full, landing around off, Marnus Labuschagne dances down the track for a lofted shot, perhaps over extra cover, but he ends up hitting it a lot straighter. Saud Shakeel wears his skates in the deep and rushes across to his left from long off. He then puts in a dive to complete the catch. Not a convincing knock from Marnus Labuschagne and he departs for a 35-ball 25.
Commentary.Howout: c Saud Shakeel b Khushdil Shah

Commentary.Commentary: Again the length is short and the line is outside off, Marnus goes back and forces it to sweeper cover for one. A boundary and three singles from this over.
Short and on off, slapped to deep cover for a single.
Loopy and full around off, Stoinis strokes it off the front foot to covers.
Strides forward and pushes a full ball down to long off for one.
Very full and around off, Marnus defends it back from the bottom half of his blade.
FOUR! A good start to the over for Australia! Loopy delivery, full and around off, Marnus Labuschagne kneels and slog-sweeps it neatly over mid-wicket for a boundary. Fine shot.
Arm ball on middle, a bit on the short side, Marnus goes back and works it to square leg for a run.
Steps down the track to a full ball but drives it straight to mid off.
Short again, around off, this time Stoinis punches it through the gap at covers for one.
Drags his length short and serves it on off, Stoinis punches from the back foot to covers.
Advances down the track to a full ball and hits it firmly down to long on for one.
Slower through the air, full and on off, it's pushed with an angled bat to point.
Loopy and full around off, a googly, it's defended back to the bowler.
Turn and bounce from around off, Marcus Stoinis hangs his bat out to dry and gets beaten.
Flatter again, around middle and leg, Stoinis goes on the back foot and blocks.
A touch flat and short on off, Marnus goes back and turns it in the gap on the leg side for one.
Gets on the front foot and strokes it with the spin to long off for another single.
Tossed up, wide outside off, Marnus Labuschagne leans forward and swats it to sweeper cover for a single.
BEATEN! This is excellent bowling from Khushdil Shah! Floated, full and outside off. Stoinis looks for a booming drive but the ball spins past his outside edge. Just a single off the over!
Fuller in length, outside off. Marcus Stoinis drives but finds the cover fielder this time.
Play and a miss! Tosses it up, outside off. Stoinis looks to drive on the up but the ball beats the outside edge.
Slower through the air, full and around off. Marcus Stoinis defends it off the front foot.
Flatter ball, around off. Marcus Stoinis keeps it out.
Floated, full and outside off. Marnus Labuschagne drives it to long off for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Marcus Stoinis pushes it back to the bowler.
Another ball, shorter in length, around off. Marcus Stoinis blocks it off the back foot.
Back of a length, around off. Marcus Stoinis keeps it out.
Back of a length on off, Marnus stays back and wrists it through square leg for a run.
Around off, on a length, played down from the crease to point.
Fuller and around off, Marnus Labuschagne drives it down to mid on.

Drinks break. A vital breakthrough for Pakistan as Ben McDermott has the reputation to go bonkers at the backend and is known for his big-hitting ability. The hosts would look to limit the damage in the coming overs by picking more wickets. Until now, their bowling has been flat but they can make things up by finishing strongly. Marcus Stoinis arrives at the crease with 17 overs left in the innings.

OUT! RUN OUT! Never run on a misfield they say, but Ben tries to steal an extra run and he perishes in doing so. This is a flatter ball, around off. Ben cuts it towards Mohammad Wasim at backward point who dives to his right but doesn't stop the ball cleanly. The ball goes past him and the batters complete two runs. Ben McDermott then decides to set off for the third run but is sent back. Wasim recovers quickly and throws the ball towards the keeper. Mohammad Rizwan grabs the ball and disturbs the stumps. Ben tries to dive to get inside the crease but he falls well short. A disappointing end to a promising knock.
Flatter and quicker, around off. Ben manages to punch it towards cover.
A quicker ball that goes on with the arm, from off. Ben defends it to cover.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Ben mistimes his cut shot past the point fielder for a brace.
Floated, on a length, around off. Ben McDermott keeps it out.
BEATEN! This is tossed up, around off and turning away slightly. Ben McDermott looks to defend but the ball beats the outside edge.
Around off, on a good length, Marnus plays it down from the back foot to point.
The batter has just blocked that from his crease.
Short and on off, forced to deep cover for a run.
Fractionally short and on off, played behind point for a run.

Wayward delivery! Short and sliding down the leg side, Marnus Labuschagne tries to pull but only gets some gloves behind it. The ball speeds behind to fine leg where Zahid Mahmood goes down low near the fence and stops it just before the fence. The replays confirm that he has done it cleanly. Two runs added to the total.

MAIDEN ODI FIFTY FOR BEN! Back of a length, around middle and leg, Ben McDermott glances it off his pads to deep square leg and reaches the landmark with a single. He will be looking for a century here and also a big finish for Australia.
Mohammad Wasim (4-0-28-0) comes back into the attack.
Very full and on middle, Ben McDermott knocks it down to long on and moves to 49 with this single.
Short and on off, punched from the back foot to covers.
Fantastic stop in the deep! Full and on middle, McDermott plays a cracking sweep shot through square leg. The ball speeds away but Fakhar Zaman makes a diving stop near the fence and saves two runs.
Tossed up, full and around middle, Ben defends it back.
Slower through the air, full and on off, Labuschagne strokes it through covers and picks up a run.
Flighted and full around off, Marnus pushes it with an angled bat to point.
Width there outside off, short in length, Marnus opens the face of his bat and guides it down to third man for a single.
Bangs it in short and around off, Ben McDermott pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Fuller and around off, driven through covers for a single.

Huge shout for a caught behind by Haris Rauf but he is the only one doing so! Nothing from Rizwan, Babar doesn't show much interest either as he talks with his bowler. Brilliant delivery, a touch short in length and outside off, seaming away, Marnus Labuschagne is caught pushing and missing inside the line. Doesn't look like an edge, even in the replays. The UltraEdge suggests nothing.

Mishit! Rauf digs in a short ball around off, Ben goes back to pull it across the line but it takes the bottom part of the bat and still has enough legs to speed down the ground. It's dropped with a dive near the fence by Hasan and he saves one run for his team.
Pitches it up and around off, Ben McDermott drives it off the front foot but picks up the short cover fielder.
Zahid continues to bowl short and around off, Ben McDermott goes on the back foot and strokes it through covers for a run. 5 singles from the over!
Stays back to a short ball and eases it with the spin to deep cover for a single.
Quicker and on middle, turned behind square leg for a run.
Around off, played from the back foot to covers.
Again the length is short, around off, Marnus gets back and punches it to sweeper cover for one.
Short and wide outside off, pushed to deep cover for a run.
This is a length ball, angling in late from middle. Marnus Labuschagne flicks it through mid-wicket and comes back for the second run.
Short of a length, outside off. Marnus Labuschagne cuts hard but Imam-ul-Haq, at backward point, dives to his right and stops the ball cleanly.
Wide! Rauf errs in line yet again and serves it way down leg. Marnus Labuschagne lets it be. Wided!
Wide! A length ball, angling down leg. Marnus Labuschagne misses his flick and the umpire calls it wide.
Good-length ball, outside off. Ben McDermott slaps it through cover and rotates the strike.

Run out chance missed! Another ball, back of a length, outside off. Marnus Labuschagne taps it towards point and takes off for a run. Ben McDermott dives to get inside the crease at the striker's end. Had that been a direct hit, it would have been curtains for Ben.
Short of a length, around off. Marnus Labuschagne stays back and defends it onto the deck.
This is full and outside off. Ben McDermott drives it through cover and takes a run.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Marnus Labuschagne blocks it off the back foot.
Ben eases this full ball towards long off and collects a single.
Floated, full and around leg. Ben McDermott prods and looks to play it across the line. He misses and gets hit on his pad.
Quicker through the air, on a length, around off. Marnus Labuschagne gets back and blocks it to the off side. The batters cross ends.
Slightly shorter in length, around off. Ben rocks back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tosses it up, around off. Ben McDermott keeps it out.
Fuller and around off, driven to covers.
Zahid Mahmood (5-0-37-1) comes back to bowl.
Yet another wide! This time it's served down the leg side, Labuschagne tries to flick it away off his pads but misses.
Wide called for height! Steep bounce on this short delivery outside off, Marnus drops his wrists and allows it through to the keeper.
Fuller and on off, it's worked on the leg side but straight to mid-wicket.
A touch short in length and outside off, McDermott taps it down in the gap at cover-point for a run.
Angles in a full ball on middle and leg, Ben McDermott brings a straight bat down and pushes it down to mid on.
Fuller in length and outside off, Ben drives but finds the cover fielder.
Use of the wrists to a full ball and Marnus Labuschagne sends it down to fine leg for a single.
Marnus Labuschagne walks in next. Also, Haris Rauf returns to bowl.

OUT! CAUGHT! Travis Head holes out! Huge, huge wicket for Pakistan and they know that. Ahmed tosses it up, around off. Head skips down a bit and tries to go over long off. Although, he plays a half-hearted shot and ends up chipping it straight down to the long off fielder. Khushdil Shah is stationed there, he runs forward and takes a good low catch. Head is gutted with his shot selection but this has been a tremendous knock from the southpaw! He has provided a solid platform for the batters to follow.
Commentary.Howout: c Khushdil Shah b Iftikhar Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: This is flatter and quicker, on middle and leg. Ben McDermott nudges it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Travis Head slaps it through cover and manages only a single as there is a fielder stationed in the deep.
On a length, around middle. Ben McDermott eases it down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Ben McDermott brings out the reverse-sweep now! This is a flatter ball, on off. Ben gets down on his knees and nails his reverse-sweep past the point fielder to bag a boundary.

HUNDRED FOR HEAD! Off just 70 balls and this is the fastest for Australia against Pakistan in ODIs. He reaches there by easing a full ball down to long off for a run. The helmet comes off, Head gets a hug from Ben McDermott and the Australian balcony is ecstatic. In the absence of David Warner, Head has stepped up big time. Can he get Australia's first individual double century in ODIs? 185* from Shane Watson is still the best and that record has stood since 2011. While batting first, the best individual score for Australia belongs to David Warner (179) which came against Pakistan and coincidently, in that game as well, Travis Head had opened and made 128.
Another delivery, back of a length, around off. Ben McDermott blocks it onto the deck.
Back of a length, around off. Ben McDermott looks to push it through cover but it goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket.
This is full and outside off. Ben prods and carves it through the cover region. Fakhar Zaman does well in the deep and keeps it to just two by moving quickly to his right.
Good-length ball, outside off. Ben McDermott pushes it towards mid off.
A slower ball, on a length, outside off. Head opens the face of his bat and steers it towards third man. They settle for a single. Head moves to 99!
Back of a length, outside off. Travis Head punches it to the extra cover fielder.
Full and outside off. Travis Head drives it to mid off and takes off for a quick single. He moves to 98 now and the 50-run stand comes up.
FOUR! SMASHED! Tossed up, around middle, Travis Head kneels and slog-sweeps it through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Floated, on leg. Ben McDermott tucks it to the leg side for a run.

A late call to review an lbw decision against Ben McDermott! He is rapped on both the pads, the inside part of the front pad and then flush on the back one. The UltraEdge shows no bat is involved but the Ball Tracking finds it to be missing the stumps. Pakistan lose a review. It was an arm ball from Khushdil Shah which skidded past the bat from the leg stump line. Mohammad Rizwan was never convinced but Babar took the word of Khushdil Shah and ended up wasting one of the reviews.
Full and drifting onto the pads. Ben McDermott nudges it behind square on the leg side for a couple of runs.
A flatter ball, going on with the angle from off. Ben McDermott stays back and defends it off the back foot.
Slightly shorter in length, around leg. Ben McDermott tucks it towards deep mid-wicket and settles for a single. He will retain the strike.
Fuller in length, on leg. Ben McDermott flicks it wide of the deep mid-wicket fielder for a brace.

Ben skips down the track so Hasan Ali drags his length back, around off. Ben McDermott attempts to flick it through square leg but he misses. The ball ricochets off his thigh pad and goes to the left of the keeper.
On a length, outside off. Ben stands tall and punches it to the extra cover fielder.
Back of a length, outside off. Head cuts it to deep point and takes a single.

Wide! Another ball is angled way down the leg side. Head misses his flick and the umpire stretches his arms to call it wide. It's not a clean take by Rizwan and he seems to have hurt his knee a little bit. Nothing serious though.
Two wides! A full ball, way down leg. Ben McDermott misses his flick and Mohammad Rizwan behind the sticks fails to grab it cleanly. The batters sneak in a bye.
Ali begins his new spell with a good-length ball, outside off. Ben prods and pushes it towards cover. Not in the gap though!
Iftikhar Ahmed is off after giving away 10 runs in his previous over. Hasan Ali (0/24 in 3 overs) returns for his second spell.
This is a flatter ball, darted on the pads. Ben McDermott stays back and nudges it around the corner for a single.
Tossed up, around off. Ben McDermott keeps it out watchfully.
FOUR! Slightly short and Ben pounces onto it! Lovely shot! Just a tad short, around middle. Ben McDermott rocks back and pulls it wide of the long on fielder to bag a boundary.
A bit quicker, on a length, around middle. Ben tucks it to mid-wicket.
Floated, on a length, on middle. Travis Head works it to long on and rotates the strike.
An overpitched ball, on middle. Ben McDermott pushes it past Babar Azam at mid-wicket towards long on for a run.
Khushdil Shah comes into the attack now. He replaces Zahid Mahmood!

FOUR! Bang, Travis Head marches into the 90s! Short in length and around off, Head goes on the back foot and bludgeons it through extra cover. The fielder in the deep tries his best to stop it with a dive but fails. 10 from the over and Australia are again getting their rhythm back!
Sliding down the leg side, eased away to deep mid-wicket for one.
Quicker and around off, pushed from the back foot to mid-wicket.
Flighted and around off, Ben McDermott plays the reverse-batted shot but finds backward point.
FOUR! Well played! Iftikhar Ahmed gives this one some air, delivers it full and close to off, Ben McDermott steps back to make room and lofts it over the bowler for a boundary at long off.
Drags his length short and bowls it around off, Head knocks it down to long off for a run.
Slightly short and on off, turning away, Ben McDermott stays back and plays it towards cover-point.
Googly around off, defended back to the bowler.
A touch short and on off, punched from the back foot to covers.
FOUR! This has been drilled! Floated one, full and around off, there is a bit of width and Ben McDermott smacks it over extra cover for his first boundary.
Loopy and full around off, Ben drives it to covers.
Slip comes in for Ben McDermott.
Flatter through the air, a googly around leg, Head works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Identical to the last delivery, again Ben McDermott plays it down from the back foot to mid-wicket. Iftikhar Ahmed is doing a good containing job as a part-timer.
Flatter and quicker on middle, Ben goes back and pushes it to mid-wicket.
Short and outside off, again Head goes on the back foot and this time punches it to sweeper cover for a run.
Goes on the back foot and connects with his back foot punch this time, finds the cover fielder.
Short and on middle, Head plays a mistimed punch back to the bowler.

Good stop in the deep! Short and on off, Head goes on the back foot and slaps it to wide long off. Rauf makes a diving stop, loses the ball for a second as it tries to sneak through his legs but he picks it up and saves two.
Loopy and landing full around middle, Ben presses forward and defends it down on the pitch.
Flighted and full on off, defended watchfully.
Edgy! Perhaps a googly, landing full and wide outside off, Ben McDermott tries to drive but ends up dragging it past the stumps to fine leg for two.
Turning away a shade from a fuller length around off, Ben McDermott opens the face of the bat a bit and pushes it to point.
Gets on the front foot and defends it with the spin to covers.
Beaten all ends up! Beauty of a delivery from Zahid! Slows this one in the air and lands it full around off, Ben leans forward to defend but it spins away to beat the bat.
Tossed up, around off, Ben allows the ball to spin back in and eases it down to long on for a run.
A touch short again, around off, Head goes back and cuts it to deep cover-point for one.
Short and wide outside off, punched past the cover fielder for a couple of runs.
Here comes the paddle sweep. Ben McDermott gets across the stumps to a full ball and helps it to fine leg for one.
Slower through the air, full and on off, Ben McDermott defends it off his front foot.
Flatter and shorter on middle, punched down to long on for a single.
This is floated, full and outside leg. Travis Head tucks it to deep square leg for a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Ben McDermott leans and drives it to deep cover for a run. He is off the mark straightaway.

Drinks break. A wicket against the run of play for Pakistan and the umpires have decided to call for this mini-break. It's been an incredible start from Australia powered by the sublime knock of Travis Head. He has batted like a man possessed and impressed with his shot selections and ability to find the gaps. Head is certainly taking out all the frustration of warming the bench in the presence of the first-choice players and showing his worth. Aaron Finch looked a bit rusty at the start but the innings of Head allowed him to settle in although his departure has opened one end for the home team. Let's see if they can capitalize. Ben McDermott is the number 3 batter.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Finally, Pakistan break the opening stand and it is the debutant, Zahid Mahmood who provides them with a much-needed breakthrough! A top delivery to get rid of the Aussie skipper. This is tossed up, outside off and spinning away a shade. Finch prods to defend but he only manages a faint outside edge which goes through to the keeper. The ball hits Mohammad Rizwan's wrist and lobs up in the air. He keeps his eyes on the ball and pouches it safely in the end. Finch walks even without waiting for the onfield decision.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Rizwan b Zahid Mahmood

Commentary.Commentary: Flighted delivery, on the pads. Travis Head clips it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Excellent use of the feet! Mahmood tosses it up, on middle. Travis Head skips down the track and smokes it way over long off for a maximum.
On a length, outside off. Aaron Finch cuts it to deep cover for one run.
That almost knocked the off stump over! This is a flatter ball, just outside off that stays a touch low. Travis Head stays back to cut but he misses and the ball goes just past the off pole.
Floated, full and outside off. Aaron Finch kneels but mistimes his sweep, wide of the deep mid-wicket fielder for a single.
Flatter ball, outside off. Travis Head cuts it to deep cover. The batters cross ends.
Slightly short and going on with the angle, from off. Finch powers it to long on for one run. 100 comes up for Australia inside the 14th over.
On a length, around middle. Travis Head eases it to long on and rotates the strike.
A quicker ball, around off. Head punches it to the cover fielder.
This is darted on the pads. Head works it behind square on the leg side for a single. 11 runs off the over and Australia are just two shy away from the 100-run mark.
Tosses it up nicely, around middle. Head pushes it back to the bowler. Much better from Zahid Mahmood!
A quicker ball, slightly shorter in length, around off. Travis Head sits back in his crease and punches hard but straight to the cover fielder.

FOUR! Zahid Mahmood errs in length and Head is not going to miss out on that! Dragged down, around off. Head rocks back and slaps it past the extra cover fielder for a cracking boundary. It's turning out to be a tough debut for Zahid.

SIX! BOOM! Take that, says Travis Head! Mahmood serves a loopy ball, on a fuller length, around middle. Head skips down a bit, kneels and slog-sweeps it way over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
BEATEN! A flat googly, on a length, outside off and turning away from the batter. Travis Head hangs back to cut but the ball spins past his blade.

In the air...but safe! Tossed up, outside off. Head looks to go inside-out over covers but he mistimes it. He ends up slicing it in the air and the ball falls just wide of Haris Rauf, running across from long off. A single taken.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Aaron Finch rocks back and cuts it to deep cover for a run.
Aaron Finch gets distracted and pulls out. Something fell from Iftikhar Ahmed's right pocket, the replay shows.

This is an arm ball, that comes in with the angle from off. Travis Head tries to cut but gets cramped for room. It goes off the inside edge towards short fine leg for a quick single. A direct hit at the striker's end but Finch had made it home.
A short ball, quicker, outside off. Aaron Finch mistimes his cut shot towards point and takes a run.
Slower through the air, full and on off. Finch prods and wrists it to mid-wicket.
Ahmed starts with a flatter ball, on middle. Head leans and works it to long on for a single.
Change in pace from both ends. Iftikhar Ahmed to bowl his part-time off breaks.
Slightly shorter in length, on middle. Head rocks back and eases it down to long on. A single to end the over. 10 runs off Zahid Mahmood's first over!
Looped up, on a length, around off. A googly probably. Finch looks to slog hard but it goes off the inner half of the bat towards long on for a run.
Flighted ball, outside off. Aaron Finch blocks it off the front foot.
SIX! Finch joins the party now! He finally gets hold of this one! Floated, full and on middle. Finch gets forward and sends it sailing way over the long on fence for a maximum.
Tosses it up, around leg. Head tickles it to short fine leg and rotates the strike.
Leg bye! Mahmood starts with a flatter ball, around leg. Finch misses his flick and gets hit on his pad, outside the line. The ball rolls away to the leg side for a leg bye.

End of Powerplay 1! Pakistan can now have a maximum of 4 fielders outside the ring till the 40th over. Also, time for some spin as the leggie, Zahid Mahmood comes into the attack. He will look to impress in his debut game.

Movement off the deck, from a shortish length around off at 144 kph, Finch jumps to defend but misses. It goes off his pads to third man and they cross. Given as a run, maybe some bat is involved. At the end of Powerplay 1, Australia are 72/0 despite the last three overs being quiet.
Takes the pace off this one and delivers it short and wide outside off, Finch flashes and misses.
Short on middle, pulled to deep square leg for a single.

Goes very full and around leg, Finch fails to flick and it goes off his pads to mid-wicket. They cross for a leg bye. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but it hits the bat of Finch instead and goes down the ground. Aaron decides not to take those runs on offer. Good sporting gesture!
Clocks 144.1 kph this time, a touch short and on off, Finch punches from the back foot but finds the fielder at cover-point.
Wide! An attempted slower bounce, at 129 clicks, but it's down the leg side and Finch makes an easy leave.
A bit short and around middle, angling down, Head tries to pull but misses. It goes off his thigh pad to the off side and they cross.
On a length around off, shaping in, Finch has his bat down in time as he punches it to covers. 7 runs in the last two overs, the runs have dried up a bit.
Shortish and around leg, Finch stays back and pulls but finds the fielder at short fine leg.

Spears in a very full ball on middle, Head walks forward and yorks himself. He then digs it out on the leg side and cross. The umpire has a word with him this time regarding running straight down the pitch.
Pitches it up and around off, Finch flicks it more from the inside edge and it goes to deep mid-wicket. They cross.

FIFTY FOR HEAD, off just 32 balls. It's a quickfire knock from him and he has not let Australia miss David Warner. Back of a length, around off, Head hangs back and drags his pull shot to deep square leg for a run. Can he get a big hundred here?
Misses out there! An overpitched delivery outside off, Head drills his drive through the line but finds the extra cover fielder.
Slower one this time, on a good length and outside off, Finch plays late but still fails to beat the diving cover-point fielder. Just 4 runs from the over!
Close to off, on a length and angling in at 142.6 kph, Aaron Finch goes back to punch but it takes the inner edge and deflects off his pads to covers. He looks for a run but is sent back.
A bit too straight in line, on a good length, Finch closes the face of his bat and works it past the mid-wicket fielder for a couple of runs.
Shortish and on off, Head taps it down to point and they cross for a run.
Finch punches this length ball in the gap at covers and scampers across for a run. Aaron ran straight down the pitch and the umpire has a quiet word with him.
Serves it on a length and outside off, Finch strokes it from the back foot but straight to the short cover fielder.
On a length and outside off, Head punches it from the back foot and this is one of those rare occasions that he has not found the gap in the cover region. Dot ball to end the over, 13 from it!
A yorker around off, Head squeezes it past the diving point fielder and comes back for the second run.
Fuller and on off, driven down the ground but straight to mid off.

SIX! This one goes all the way! For a moment, it looked like a mishit but it has cleared the fence. Mohammad Wasim digs it in short, around middle, Travis Head swivels on the back foot and pulls it across the line. It flies from the upper half of his bat and goes over deep square leg for a maximum.
FOUR! Boom! 50 up for Australia in no time. Travis Head is on fire! His 9th four now. Mohammad Wasim pitches it up and around off, Travis Head powers it over mid off for  a boundary.
Around middle and leg, on a length, Finch skips down the track and tries to flick but misses. It goes off his pads to backward point and they cross. Given as a run, may have been some inside edge.
Mohammad Wasim (2-0-12-0) comes back to bowl.

FOUR! That's some shot! Head continues his merry way, in the meantime. Slightly short in length and on off, Head rocks on the back foot and punches it sweetly through the gap at covers. He is piercing those gaps with surgical precision.

Shout for an lbw, not given! Haris Rauf delivers an inswinger, landing around off and nipping in. Finch tries to flick but is beaten for pace and movement. It deflects off his pads to backward point and the batters cross as Rauf appeals. Going down, perhaps, may have clipped the leg stump at the most. Given as a leg bye.
Swing and a miss! That's a sharp short delivery, around off at 140.7 kph, Aaron Finch attempts to unveil a pull shot but it flies over his blade.
Fuller this time, landing around off, Finch drives it from the inner half to mid on.
Serves it on a length and outside off, Finch drives off the front foot but finds the cover fielder.

Bang on target, this time. Around off, on a length, shaping back in a touch, Aaron Finch looks to defend near his front pad but it takes the inner edge and speeds behind square leg. They collect a couple of runs.
Wide! False start from Rauf. Slips a length ball down the leg side, Finch tries to flick but misses.
With the runs leaking, will Babar Azam go to one of his spinners? The answer is no although there is a bowling change. Haris Rauf to operate from this end, replacing Mohammad Wasim.
Finally a dot ball for Pakistan! This is a length ball, angling in from outside off. Travis Head covers the line of the ball and defends it to cover. Another good over for Australia, 14 runs off it!

FOUR! WOW! Simply amazing from the southpaw! He is not allowing the bowlers to settle! Shorter in length, outside off. Head stays back and cuts it over the point fielder. The ball races away to the fence.
FOUR! Picks the bones out of that one! Ali pitches it up this time, outside off. Head sits back and smacks it over the mid off fielder. Two bounces and over the ropes.
Good-length delivery, around middle and leg. Head flicks it through mid-wicket and comes back for the second run.
FOUR! SMASHED! Head is taking the attack to Pakistan early on! A length ball, outside off. Head frees his arms and smashes it past the diving mid off fielder for yet another boundary.
Hasan Ali comes 'round the wicket and bowls it on a good length, around off. Travis Head is squared up a bit and it goes off the inner half of the blade and onto the deck.
A bit full and outside off. Travis Head mistimes his cover drive, wide of the mid off fielder and scampers through to the other end. 8 runs off the over!
On a length and around off. Travis Head dabs it down on the deck, off the back foot.
Wasim changes his angle and comes 'round the wicket. He hurls a length ball, around off, that cramps Head for room. He just blocks it towards cover.

FOUR! WHACKED! Travis Head is on the march! This is a back-of-a-length delivery, just outside off. Head rides the bounce nicely and punches it past the diving fielder at covers for a boundary - his fourth already.
Wasim serves a good-length ball, nipping back in just that little bit, from middle. Head stands tall and nudges it to mid-wicket.
Nicely worked! A length ball, angling in from middle, Finch tucks it around the corner, behind square on the leg side. The batters push hard and collect three runs in total.
Back of a length, just outside off. Travis Head punches hard but straight to the backward point fielder.
FOUR! Nails his shot this time! Boy, he is looking in some form! Fuller in length, outside off. Travis Head prods and strokes it through covers for another boundary.
Play and a miss! Shorter in length, angling across the batter, from outside off. Travis Head throws the kitchen sink at it but fails to make any connection.
Wide! This is a wayward ball, down leg. Travis Head misses his heave on the leg side. The umpire signals a wide.
FOUR! This has been hammered through the gap! Full in length and outside off, Travis Head leans into the drive and crunches it through extra cover for a glorious boundary.
Mishit! A touch short and around off, angling away, Head hangs back to punch it through the line but mistimes it off the inner edge to the leg side.
Sliding down the leg side, at 136 kph, Finch walks across with the flick shot but misses. It goes off his pads and rolls to the left side of the keeper. They cross for a leg bye.
Short of a length, around off. Travis Head taps it towards backward point.
FOUR! CRUNCHED! Back of a length, well outside off. Travis Head sits back and smashes it through the cover-point region to bag a boundary.

APPEAL FOR AN LBW! The finger has gone up but Travis Head takes the DRS and gets the decision changed. A length ball from Mohammad Wasim, around leg. Travis Head misses his flick and gets hit on his back pad. Pakistan appeal and up goes the finger. Travis Head though opts for a review straightaway. The Ball Tracking rolls in and shows that the ball had pitched outside leg. The on-field decision needs to be overturned.
Back of a length, around off. Travis Head blocks it off the back foot.
Two leg byes! A full ball, around leg. Head misses his flick and gets hit low on his pad. The ball rolls away towards fine leg and the batters collect a couple of leg byes.
Crunched but for no run! Fuller in length, outside off. Travis Head slashes hard but finds the cover fielder.
Who will bowl from the other end? Debutant Mohammad Wasim has been given the responsibility to start with the second new ball. Two slips in place.
Another ball that is on a length, around off. Aaron Finch defends it towards mid off. A tidy start from Hasan Ali, just 1 run off the first over.
Aaron Finch advances down the track so Hasan Ali serves it wider, outside off. Finch shoulders his arms to it.
Back of a length, well outside off. Aaron Finch looks to cut hard but the ball goes past his blade.

An appeal for LBW from Hasan Ali but the umpire is not interested! A length ball, nipping back in sharply from outside off. Finch looks to defend off the front foot with his bat and pad together. Hasan feels that it's pad first and appeals. The finger stays down. Pakistan eventually decide not to take the DRS.
This is a good-length delivery, around off. Finch gets forward and blocks it solidly towards cover.

Hasan Ali begins with a full ball, angling across the batter from off. Travis Head looks to drive but it goes off the outer half of the blade towards third man. The batters cross ends. Australia are up and running!
Right then, all the pre-match formalities are done! Aaron Finch and Travis Head are the chosen openers for Australia. It is going to be Hasan Ali to bowl with the first new ball. Here we go...
The players from both teams are out in the middle and first, the national anthems will be played. It's extremely hot conditions in Lahore, nearly 40 degrees Celsius.
Australia (Playing XI) - Aaron Finch (C), Travis Head, Ben McDermott, Marnus Labuschagne, Marcus Stoinis, Cameron Green, Alex Carey (WK), Sean Abbott, Nathan Ellis, Adam Zampa, Mitchell Swepson.
Pakistan (Playing XI) - Babar Azam (C), Fakhar Zaman, Imam-ul-Haq, Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Saud Shakeel, Iftikhar Ahmed, Khushdil Shah, Hasan Ali, Mohammad Wasim, Haris Rauf, Zahid Mahmood.
TOSS - Up goes the coin and it lands in favour of Babar Azam. Pakistan have elected to BOWL first.

DEBUT ALERT - Both Australia and Pakistan have confirmed two debutants each for this game. Nathan Ellis and Mitchell Swepson are set to make their ODI debuts today. For Pakistan, it is Zahid Mahmood and Mohammad Wasim who have been handed over their ODI caps.

BREAKING NEWS - Ashton Agar has been ruled out of the ODI series, as he has tested positive for Covid-19 ahead of the first ODI. Josh Inglis won't be available for this series as well, having previously tested positive for Covid-19.

Pakistan are a very solid unit on paper, having plenty of match-winners in their ranks. They would be going in with a full-strength squad and Babar Azam and his troops would be confident of their chances heading into the first ODI, in spite of losing the Test series against the same opposition. They have got all their bases covered and will certainly start as favourites. One thing is for sure, we have a cracking contest coming up between two quality sides. Stay tuned for toss and further updates.

The Aaron Finch-led Australian side is a good blend of youth and experience and we could see a couple of their players making their ODI debut as well. The Aussies would be playing without their pace trio of Starc, Cummins and Hazlewood but having said that, they have included some exciting young pacers and not to forget the all-rounders who provide them with the right balance.

The first of the three-match ODI series between Australia and Pakistan is set to commence shortly at the Gaddafi Stadium in Lahore and it promises to be a cracker of a game between two heavyweights. Yes, the Aussies are depleted with some of their star players missing out due to various reasons but we are certainly aware of the threat that the mighty Australians possess. On that note, a very warm welcome to our coverage of the first ODI.
